title: NDA Full Length Mock Test 02 (Hard Level)
description: National Defence Academy style full-length mock covering Mathematics, English and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions, 120 minutes.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
The paper covers Mathematics, English and General Knowledge as in NDA GAT/Maths combined mock.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Each of the soldiers / were given / a medal / for bravery.
